integrity: All 72 admissible words and 1168 compatibility edges are regenerated from the definitions.
All maximal cliques are enumerated, and an independent increasing-order recursion re-enumerates all six-cliques.
All claimed distance and subgroup-orbit properties are checked for every maximum code.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to length four, GC-content two, and distance threshold three.
The orbit statement concerns the explicitly defined 64-element subgroup and does not claim the full automorphism group.
The exact optimum six is prior work; the new content is the equality-case census and structure.
An obscure or unindexed prior finite census remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete equality-case census for \(A_{4}^{GC,RC}(4,3,2)\)
